distribution.narrative: Do not promote Taiwan to Present from Beaver & Liu (2010) alone. The source associates the species with Taiwan through imported bamboo but does not provide new direct Taiwan locality material.

hosts.scientific_name: stems including bamboo and rattans, and seeds

host_note: The source characterizes the species as polyphagous, including stems of bamboo and rattans and seeds. This broad ecological statement is retained without inventing additional host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus fuscicollis (Eichhoff, 1878).
